build.buildCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "untch-web" ]; then pnpm --filter @untch/web build; else echo "no build step for $RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME"; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "untch-receipt-writer" ]; then pnpm --filter @untch/receipt-writer worker; elif [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "untch-web" ]; then pnpm --filter @untch/web start; else pnpm --filter @untch/asp start; fi
